worldcombat.skill.toxic.summary: Spit venom that deepens over time, making native poison pulses more frequent. Curing it immediately stops further escalation; expiry lets it fade.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.0: The venom flies at %2$s blocks per tick toward a target within %1$s blocks, with a flight hit radius of %3$s blocks; terrain in the way or a dodge makes it fizzle.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.1: On a hit the target is badly poisoned; every %1$s ticks the poison deepens one stage up to stage %3$s, and each deeper stage makes the poison damage tick more often. The venom lasts at most %2$s. Poison- and Steel-type or otherwise poison-immune targets cannot be poisoned, so the move does nothing to them.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.description.2: Native poison settles the damage, including immunity, mitigation and its minimum-health rule. Curing poison immediately stops escalation.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.0: Open by poisoning a tough target
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.1: Turn a hard fight into a war of attrition
worldcombat.skill.toxic.use.2: Force the target to spend a cure or retreat
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.virul: On: shorter duration (x0.72), faster escalation (interval x0.62). Off: longer duration (x1.08) with slower escalation for sustained pressure.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of spitting. Larger values chase harder and whiff more in the open.
worldcombat.skill.toxic.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to apply venom; when off, it only spits at what it can reach from where it stands.
